xBRIEFInfo.description: Story xBRIEF for #3657 variant-table relaxation; bound SoT successor lean v2 5389165245.

plan.title: fix(design-critique): variant table under-describes -- relax the panel conjunction, add a constrained-author trigger

narratives.Description: The Stop 2 variant table cannot express the selection the #3651 arc needed, and it states no rule for how its rows are evaluated. Two changes survive critique: the panel row grants permission for N>=3 on open solution space or high blast radius alone (dropping the 'No defensible presumption, and' conjunct), and the evaluation rule is written down. Change 2 from the as-filed body (a constrained-author trigger) is REJECTED and stays rejected.
narratives.Overview: Bound source of truth is successor lean v2 5389165245, which supersedes 5389155567. The as-filed body proposed the widened row SELECT panel; critique narrowed it to PERMIT. Title still reads 'add a constrained-author trigger' from the as-filed shape -- that change is rejected in the bound body; do not implement it. Shared file content/contracts/design-critique.md is contended with #3651, #3660, #3661 (four disjoint regions, file contention only, no semantic conflict). This cohort sequences #3657 first, then #3651 rebased on it -- do not parallelize. Change 3's charter-versus-spend separation is marked parent-originated and unaudited in the bound body; the implementer may instead choose the critic's explicit priority-order form.
narratives.Labels: bug, design, process, area:skills, status:child, design-critique:triage-ready
narratives.UserStory: As a parent selecting a critique variant at Stop 2, I want the panel row to be reachable for a well-specified issue with high blast radius, and I want a stated rule for how the rows are evaluated, so that a panel can be authorized without contradicting the table that authorizes it.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Edit the Stop 2 variant table in content/contracts/design-critique.md (measured at head 8bb1e528 as :34-38): panel row condition becomes 'a genuinely open solution space or high blast radius', dropping 'No defensible presumption, and'; the granted variant is N>=3 permitted, not selected. 2. Record the normative reason for permission-not-compulsion in the contract (serial reiteration is anchored by a parent-authored disagreement map correlated with round 1 by construction -- the same correlation :193 refuses to count as confirmation; parallel critics carry independent priors). 3. Add the evaluation rule: charter selection (:36 / :37) and spend permission (:38) are evaluated independently -- or the critic's explicit priority-order form, implementer's choice, with the chosen form stated. 4. Add the supersede line citing #3434 disposition comment 5364365428 item 4, which deliberately accepted the current wording on 2026-08-20. 5. Lock the EVALUATION RULE in packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/design_critique_contract.test.ts -- not the row prose; a test preserving only 'panel' and '#3383' would not catch this defect again. 6. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line. Bound SoT: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3657#issuecomment-5389165245.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Successor lean v2 5389165245 is bound SoT. Synthesis accepted 5389174889. Change 2 (constrained-author trigger) is REJECTED -- role-and-clearance is owned by :193 Decorrelation and :195 Non-self-arbitration, and is #3651's subject. Out of scope: a two-axis table restructure (parent-originated, unaudited, follow-up candidate); changing the N>=3 floor; round-3+ ceiling and parallel-critic accounting (#3660); everything in #3651.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Nine acceptance clauses match the bound issue checklist. They exceed the 2-5 swarm default because each obligation is independently pin-testable and two of them (permission-not-selection, evaluation rule) are the substance of the critique.

items.title: Panel row fires without the defensible-presumption conjunct

narrative.When: When the Stop 2 table is read, the panel row condition is a genuinely open solution space or high blast radius, with no 'No defensible presumption' conjunct.
narrative.Acceptance: When the Stop 2 table is read, the panel row condition is a genuinely open solution space or high blast radius, with no 'No defensible presumption' conjunct.

items.title: Panel row grants permission, not selection

narrative.When: When the panel row fires, it grants N>=3 as permitted rather than selected, and the contract records the normative reason for availability without compulsion.
narrative.Acceptance: When the panel row fires, it grants N>=3 as permitted rather than selected, and the contract records the normative reason for availability without compulsion.

items.title: A 3651-shaped issue is authorized for a panel

narrative.When: When an issue has drafted MUSTs, no refutation target, and whole-motion blast radius, the table authorizes a panel.
narrative.Acceptance: When an issue has drafted MUSTs, no refutation target, and whole-motion blast radius, the table authorizes a panel.

items.title: Evaluation rule is stated and resolves the overlap

narrative.When: When an issue matches both the refutation and panel conditions, the contract states an explicit evaluation rule that gives it a defined outcome, and the refutation and default rows are unchanged in behaviour.
narrative.Acceptance: When an issue matches both the refutation and panel conditions, the contract states an explicit evaluation rule that gives it a defined outcome, and the refutation and default rows are unchanged in behaviour.

items.title: Change 2 stays rejected with a recorded why

narrative.When: When the constrained-author trigger is looked for, it is absent, and the reason for rejecting it is recorded in the contract or on the issue rather than nowhere.
narrative.Acceptance: When the constrained-author trigger is looked for, it is absent, and the reason for rejecting it is recorded in the contract or on the issue rather than nowhere.

items.title: Content-contract test locks the evaluation rule

narrative.When: When design_critique_contract tests run, they lock the evaluation rule rather than the row prose; a test that preserved only 'panel' and '#3383' would not catch this defect again.
narrative.Acceptance: When design_critique_contract tests run, they lock the evaluation rule rather than the row prose; a test that preserved only 'panel' and '#3383' would not catch this defect again.

items.title: Supersede line cites the accepted prior decision

narrative.When: When the edited table is read, it carries an explicit supersede line citing #3434 disposition comment 5364365428 item 4, which deliberately accepted the prior wording.
narrative.Acceptance: When the edited table is read, it carries an explicit supersede line citing #3434 disposition comment 5364365428 item 4, which deliberately accepted the prior wording.

narrative.When: When CHANGELOG.md is read, [Unreleased] contains one brief release-notes line for this story.
narrative.Acceptance: When CHANGELOG.md is read, [Unreleased] contains one brief release-notes line for this story.
